ground_truth_event.cause: Severe torque fluctuations (> 28 kN.m) due to hole cleaning deficit and dogleg severity in Girujan clays
ground_truth_event.mitigation: Pumped high-viscosity tandem sweep. Back-reamed 12 stands with maximum flow rate.
ground_truth_event.outcome: Torque stabilized back to 16 kN.m. Resumed drilling.

ground_truth_event.cause: Encountered high-pressure gas sand stringer in Upper Barail; sudden D-exponent drop and pit gain of 2.4 m3
ground_truth_event.mitigation: Shut-in on annular BOP. Recorded SIDPP=380 psi, SICP=520 psi. Circulated gas bubble via Wait & Weight method. Weighted up mud to 1.44 sg.
ground_truth_event.outcome: Well killed safely after 16 hours. Resumed drilling with zero gas units.

ground_truth_event.cause: Encountered high-pressure gas sand stringer in Upper Barail; sudden D-exponent drop and pit gain of 2.4 m3

ground_truth_event.cause: Natural micro-fractures in Tipam sands intersected under high ECD (> 1.34 sg)
ground_truth_event.mitigation: Spotted 30 ppb coarse LCM pill (NutPlug + Mica). Reduced pump rate from 2400 to 2050 LPM. Reduced mud weight to 1.28 sg.
ground_truth_event.outcome: Full circulation regained after 7.5 hours NPT. Drilling resumed with controlled ECD.

ground_truth_event.cause: Reactive Kopili shale sloughing and pack-off during wiper trip; overpull exceeded 140 klbs
ground_truth_event.mitigation: Jarred downwards at 110 klbs overpull. Spotted 50 bbl glycol-based lubricant pill. Worked pipe with 35 RPM rotation.
ground_truth_event.outcome: String freed after 11 hours. Conditioned mud with KCl-Polymer inhibitor.
